title: Aayi Shumr E Pur Jor O Jafa Zalim Amman Az Tishnagi
body:
Aayi Shumr E Pur Jor O Jafa Zalim Amman Az Tishnagi
Aayi Kafir Daur Az Khuda Zalim Aamaan Az Tishnagi
1. Man Zada'ah Paighambarm Nor E Do Chashme Hyderam
Rahmi Bahaal E Muztaram Zalim Aamaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Gham Haye Daura'n Ek Taraf Zakhm E Faradaan Ek Taraf
Daghe Jawaan'an Ek Taraf Zalim Amaan......
